verdict.rationale: Nitrokey makes hardware security keys and HSMs for authentication, OpenPGP, PIV and FIDO2. A user-definable engine for event-triggered automation rules is not something this kind of product offers or that buyers would compare it on, so the story is a category error. Touch confirmation and the nitropy CLI are device-interaction features, not automation rules, so they do not make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
